description: late-elision does not make maximal redundant. On A X B, the one complete derivation uses body → X and elides T, but maximal forbids that elision, since body → X B is longer. So the text is rejected at T (engine §4, §6).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision maximal
%rule text A body [+T] B
%rule body X | X B
